investigation: Root Cause of 46.06% Reachability in Uniform HNSW
findings: The 46.06% reachability reported in Phase 5.0 was an INSTRUMENTATION ARTIFACT of performing directed BFS strictly on Layer 0 starting from the hierarchical enter_point. In HNSW, enter_point is selected purely by geometric coin flips at the highest layer. Because Layer 0 has directed edge pruning (shrink_neighborhood drops reciprocal back-edges), a single node may not reach 100% of Layer 0 purely via directed forward edges. However, Weakly Connected Components (WCC) is 100% (1 component) and Hierarchical Search Success is 100%.
